mechanism: Both drugs have anticholinergic effects and tolterodine is metabolized by CYP2D6, which metoprolol also undergoes, leading to potential pharmacokinetic interaction and additive anticholinergic effects.
action: Monitor for anticholinergic side effects (constipation, urinary retention, dry mouth, dizziness); consider dose adjustments if excessive anticholinergic symptoms develop; tolterodine may increase metoprolol levels via CYP2D6 inhibition.
